glossary.definition: (C) For purposes of this section, "community water system" means a public water system that serves at least fifteen service connections used by year-round residents or t hat regularly serves at least twenty-five year-round residents.
glossary.source_title: Section 6109.08 - Owner or operator to provide financial assurance.

glossary.definition: For purposes of this section, "public entity" means the federal government, the state, any political subdivision, and any agency, institution, or instrumentality thereof.
